Day 1 · Arrival at Santiago de Chile airport and transfer to your hotel with your private guide.

Santiago combines fine dining, beautifully landscaped gardens, a famous seafood market and the stunning backdrop of the Andes. In recent years the city has invested in new cultural centres, museums and green parks: the upscale neighbourhoods of Vitacura and El Golf are home to stylish art galleries, while the historic Barrio Brasil is known for its vibrant public art.
